name: Customer Registration & Profile Bootstrap
description: Allows a new or existing customer to register/login by providing name, phone, optional email, address, and profile picture URL. Creates customer record and returns JWT pair.
notes: Validates 10-digit Indian phone format; handles upsert/conflict

name: Worker Registration & Onboarding
description: Allows a worker to register by phone number with basic profile details (name, skill category, daily rate). Enforces phone uniqueness and initializes worker in PENDING_VERIFICATION state.
notes: Enforces unique phone index

name: Unified Phone OTP Request
description: Generates a 6-digit cryptographic OTP, stores hashed value in Redis with 5-minute TTL, and enforces sliding window rate limiting (max 5 OTPs per 10 minutes per phone). Dispatches SMS via provider.
notes: Redis atomic sliding window; mock OTP bypass available in non-production test mode

name: Unified Phone OTP Verification & Login
description: Validates submitted OTP against Redis hash with constant-time comparison, invalidates OTP upon successful verification, resolves user role, creates a new session in RefreshToken table, and issues short-lived JWT access token (15m) and refresh token (7d).
notes: Constant-time hash comparison prevents timing side-channels

name: Customer Direct Login
description: Direct login endpoint for customers with existing registered phone number.
notes: Alternative to OTP verify for pre-authenticated/test flows

name: Worker Direct Login
description: Direct login endpoint for workers by phone number.
notes: Returns worker profile and tokens

name: Refresh Token Rotation with Reuse Detection
description: Rotates an active refresh token: marks old token used, creates child token in family. If an already-used token is presented (potential token theft), revokes entire token family immediately.
notes: Family-based token replay detection implemented

name: User Logout & Session Revocation
description: Revokes the presented refresh token and blacklists the active JWT access token in Redis until its natural expiration.
notes: Dual invalidation: DB record revoked + Redis token blacklist

name: Session Family Audit & Remote Revocation
description: Allows an authenticated user to list all active login sessions/devices and terminate individual sessions or all other sessions.
notes: Enforces user isolation on session management

name: Customer Profile Retrieval & Update
description: Fetches the current authenticated customer profile and allows updating name, email, address, and profile picture.
notes: Guarded by authenticateCustomer middleware

name: Customer FCM Device Registration & Revocation
description: Registers mobile FCM device tokens for push notifications with device type and app version, and allows revoking tokens on logout.
notes: Supports multi-device token management

name: Customer Notification Inbox & Acknowledgment
description: Fetches persistent notification history for customer with unread count and allows marking notifications as read/acknowledged.
notes: Synchronized across HTTP API and Socket.IO

name: Worker Profile Management
description: Fetches current worker profile, skills, documents status, verification badge, and allows updating operational parameters (daily rate, experience, bio).
notes: Guarded by authenticateWorker middleware

name: Worker Online/Offline Status Toggle
description: Sets worker status to ONLINE or OFFLINE. When going ONLINE, verifies that worker is APPROVED/ACTIVE and has an active location.
notes: Directly controls eligibility for dispatch matching

name: Worker Document Upload Flow
description: Generates secure pre-signed PUT upload URL for identity documents (AADHAAR, PAN, DRIVING_LICENSE, POLICE_VERIFICATION), registers document record in PENDING state.
notes: Storage provider generates HMAC-signed upload URLs; transitions worker verificationStatus

name: Worker Document View URL Generation
description: Generates a time-limited HMAC-signed GET URL for the worker to securely preview their own uploaded identity documents.
notes: Enforces worker ownership of requested document

name: Worker Booking History & Schedule
description: Returns paginated list of worker bookings filtered by status (CONFIRMED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED).
notes: Includes customer name, job details, and OTP requirements

name: Worker Earnings & Analytics
description: Computes worker completed jobs count, total gross earnings, platform commission deductions, and pending payouts.
notes: Calculates metrics from completed bookings and payment records

name: Worker Device Registration & Revocation
description: Registers worker FCM device tokens for real-time dispatch alerts and push notifications, and allows token deregistration.
notes: Ensures worker receives job dispatch notifications

name: Customer Job Creation with Requirements & Demands
description: Creates a job draft or published job with location coordinates, address, schedule (immediate vs scheduled), and nested skill requirements specifying headcount and wage per worker. Runs in Prisma transaction.
notes: Triggers dispatch wave job creation if autoDispatch is enabled

name: Customer Job Listing & History
description: Retrieves all jobs created by authenticated customer with status filtering, requirement fulfillment counts, and active bookings.
notes: Paginated, sorted by creation date descending

name: Job Detail Inspection
description: Fetches granular job details including requirements, filled worker slots, start OTP, and linked bookings. Enforces role-based visibility (workers can only view if dispatched or booked).
notes: Start OTP is masked for workers until booking is confirmed

name: Job Requirement Dynamic Management
description: Allows customer to add additional skill requirements or update headcounts on an active, unfilled job.
notes: Disallows modification if requirement is already fully filled or booking started

name: Customer Job Cancellation
description: Cancels a job if it has not started. Automatically cancels all pending dispatches, releases worker locks, updates all associated bookings to CANCELLED, and emits notification events.
notes: Atomic transaction; releases pending worker dispatch locks

name: Worker Location Ingestion via HTTP
description: Ingests worker GPS latitude/longitude, validates coordinate bounds (-90 to +90, -180 to +180), updates worker PostGIS geometry point and lastLocationAt timestamp, and records audit breadcrumb.
notes: Updates PostGIS Point(lon, lat, 4326); verified in PostgreSQL

name: Worker Real-Time Location Stream via Socket.IO
description: Worker sends real-time GPS coordinates over websocket event worker:location_update. Broadcasts coordinate to customer room booking:<bookingId> if worker is currently engaged in an active booking.
notes: Broadcasting scoped strictly to customers holding active bookings with that worker

name: Customer Live Worker Tracking Endpoint
description: Allows customer to fetch current GPS coordinates, accuracy, and last updated timestamp for the worker assigned to their active booking.
notes: Guarded by booking customer authorization

name: PostGIS Radial Worker Matching Query
description: Queries eligible workers using PostGIS ST_DWithin geography index, filtering by active skill ID, status ONLINE, verificationStatus APPROVED, not currently in active booking, and location freshness (<30m). Orders by distance ascending.
notes: PostGIS ST_DWithin spatial index verified against Supabase PostgreSQL

name: Wave-Based Dispatch Orchestration with Timeout Queue
description: Dispatches job requirements in concentric or tiered waves (batch of K workers per slot). Schedules a BullMQ timeout job (e.g. 60s per wave). If wave expires without acceptance, next wave is triggered until radius or candidate pool exhausted.
notes: Dual alerting: Emits job:incoming Socket.IO event and enqueues FCM push notification

name: Worker Incoming Dispatch Poll & Detail
description: Allows worker to poll current active dispatches addressed to them, view job location, estimated distance, wage, and remaining response time.
notes: Filters out expired or cancelled waves

name: Worker Dispatch Acceptance & Atomic Booking Creation
description: Worker accepts incoming dispatch. Executes inside serializable/isolated transaction: checks slot availability, marks dispatch ACCEPTED, cancels competing dispatches in wave, generates start OTP, creates Booking, updates requirement filled count. If requirement full, marks requirement/job FULFILLED.
notes: Fully atomic transaction prevents double-booking of requirement slots

name: Worker Dispatch Decline / Rejection
description: Worker explicitly declines a dispatch offer. Marks DispatchWaveWorker REJECTED and checks if wave needs early advancement to next candidate.
notes: Frees wave slot early instead of waiting for timeout

name: Automated Dispatch Reconciliation & Orphan Recovery
description: Scheduled background task running every 30 seconds that scans for expired dispatch waves with unhandled timeouts or lost BullMQ jobs, marks them EXPIRED, and advances the wave engine.
notes: Self-healing background worker prevents stuck dispatches

name: Booking Detail Inspection
description: Retrieves booking details including customer contact, worker profile, scheduled time, current status, agreed rate, and payment status.
notes: Authorizes only participating customer, assigned worker, or admin

name: Worker Arrival & Start Job via Customer OTP Verification
description: Worker arrives at job site and submits customer start OTP. Backend verifies OTP against booking record, transitions booking state from CONFIRMED to IN_PROGRESS, sets startedAt timestamp, and records audit trail.
notes: Enforces OTP verification before work can legally commence

name: Worker Job Completion Submission
description: Worker signals work completed. Backend transitions booking status to WORKER_COMPLETED or PENDING_CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION and notifies customer to inspect work and release payment.
notes: Triggers notification to customer for confirmation and review

name: Customer Completion Confirmation & Rating Prompt
description: Customer accepts worker completion. Sets booking status to COMPLETED, marks finishedAt timestamp, releases worker to ONLINE/IDLE, and prompts for worker rating/review.
notes: Finalizes booking lifecycle

name: Booking Cancellation with Penalty/Reason Handling
description: Cancels an active booking before start. Records cancellation reason and cancelledBy actor, frees worker back to ONLINE, and emits real-time cancellation alert.
notes: Rejects cancellation if booking is already IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED

name: Razorpay Order Creation for Booking
description: Calculates booking payable amount (wage + platform fee + tax), creates a cryptographic Razorpay Order via SDK, and stores initial Payment record with status PENDING.
notes: Returns razorpayOrderId, currency, and keyId to mobile client

name: Razorpay Webhook Ingestion & Signature Verification
description: Receives asynchronous Razorpay webhooks (order.paid, payment.captured, payment.failed). Validates webhook HMAC SHA-256 signature using raw request body, updates Payment status to SUCCESS/FAILED, and updates Booking paymentStatus to PAID.
notes: Configured with express.raw middleware to ensure accurate HMAC byte calculation

name: Booking Payment Status Query
description: Retrieves payment status, transaction reference, amount, and receipt for a given booking.
notes: Provides payment verification for clients

name: Payment Refund Initiation (Database State Only)
description: Marks payment record as REFUNDED in database upon cancellation. NOTE: Currently does not dispatch the live Razorpay API refund call (gateway call stubbed/deferred).
notes: Executes real razorpay.payments.refund SDK call; captures refundId and writes REFUND_COMPLETED outbox event

name: Payment Reconciliation Worker
description: Background worker running on payment-reconciliation queue that handles stuck pending payments and verifies gateway statuses.
notes: Started in lifecycleManager

name: Booking In-App Chat over Socket.IO
description: Real-time peer-to-peer messaging between customer and worker within an active booking. Validates membership in booking room, persists message to ChatMessage table, and broadcasts to room booking:<id>.
notes: Enforces authorization: only customer or worker associated with the booking can join room

name: Historical Chat Message Fetch via HTTP
description: Fetches paginated chat message history for a booking with sender identity, timestamps, and read indicators.
notes: Includes rate limiting and ownership validation

name: HTTP Fallback Chat Message Send
description: Allows sending chat message via REST API when websocket connection is degraded. Stores message and triggers notification.
notes: Mirrors socket persistence and emits socket event to room

name: Transactional Outbox Notification Dispatch
description: Application services write notification events to OutboxEvent table within the same DB transaction as business state changes. OutboxWorker polls pending events with lease locks and dispatches them.
notes: Guarantees at-least-once notification dispatch; prevents dual-write anomalies

name: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) Push Delivery
description: Notification worker reads worker/customer device tokens and dispatches push notifications via Firebase Admin SDK. Prunes invalid/unregistered device tokens automatically.
notes: Firebase Admin SDK initialized with staging service account credentials

name: Real-Time Socket.IO Notification Delivery
description: Directly emits notification events to connected user personal rooms (customer:<id>, worker:<id>) for instant in-app alerts.
notes: Provides instant toast notifications while app is in foreground

name: Canonical Skill Directory Browsing
description: Returns list of active canonical skills with category, baseline hourly rate, and description for job posting and worker profile selection.
notes: Public catalog; cached in memory/Redis

name: Admin Skill Creation & Activation Toggle
description: Allows administrators to register new trade skills into the marketplace catalog and activate or deactivate existing skills.
notes: Guarded by authenticateAdmin middleware

name: Customer Review & Rating Submission
description: Customer submits a 1-5 star review with optional written feedback for a completed booking. Updates Worker aggregate rating and reviewCount inside an atomic transaction.
notes: Enforces unique review per booking; rejects duplicate submissions

name: Worker Public Review Listing
description: Fetches paginated list of verified customer reviews for a given worker profile.
notes: Sanitizes customer personal identifiers

name: Worker Directory & Verification Queue with Filters
description: Lists all workers with filters by verificationStatus (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED), status (ONLINE, OFFLINE, SUSPENDED), and skill.
notes: Strictly guarded by authenticateAdmin

name: Worker Document Inspection via Admin Signed URL
description: Generates secure HMAC-signed download URL for admin auditors to inspect submitted KYC documents (Aadhaar/PAN/license).
notes: Admin can inspect private files without exposing storage keys

name: Worker Document KYC Verification / Rejection
description: Admin approves or rejects a worker document with rejection reason. If all mandatory documents are approved, automatically updates worker verificationStatus to APPROVED.
notes: Triggers notification to worker regarding verification result

name: Worker Account Suspension & Reinstatement
description: Suspends an abusive worker account or reinstates an existing worker. Suspended workers are immediately booted offline and disqualified from dispatch matching.
notes: Immediately invalidates worker session tokens

name: System-Wide Marketplace Job & Booking Monitoring
description: Admin dashboard endpoint listing all platform jobs and bookings with status filters, date range filters, and anomaly flags.
notes: Enables operational oversight

name: Admin Audit Log Retrieval
description: Fetches immutable audit log entries recording administrative interventions, document approvals, and state overrides.
notes: Provides governance compliance trail

name: HMAC Signed Object Upload & Download Service
description: Provides signed URL endpoints (/download/:key, /upload/:key, /api/storage/signed-url) that validate cryptographic signatures with expiry timestamps before streaming files to/from local or S3-compatible storage.
notes: Secures private worker KYC documents from unauthorized direct downloads

name: Liveness & Readiness Health Probes
description: Provides Kubernetes-standard /health/live and /health/ready probes that verify PostgreSQL database connection, Redis ping, BullMQ worker status, and memory thresholds.
notes: Returns 200 OK or 503 Service Unavailable

name: Prometheus Metrics Exposition
description: Exposes standard Prometheus metrics (/metrics) for HTTP request duration, error rates, database connection pool stats, and active websocket connections.
notes: Standard Prometheus format output

name: Daily Location & Stale OTP Cleanup Cron
description: Background cron job running daily to purge worker location breadcrumbs older than 30 days and delete expired OTP records.
notes: Maintains database size bounds and compliance with data retention policies
